title: VTG Playboy Magazine May 1989 - Featuring Soviet Russia’s First Sex Star
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from May 1989, featuring the first sex star from Soviet Russia. This magazine provides a unique glimpse into the cultural and social norms of the time, showcasing exclusive interviews, articles, and pictorials related to the world of entertainment and lifestyle. A must-have for collectors and enthusiasts of vintage magazines, this item offers a nostalgic look back at the popular culture of the late 1980s.
